summary: Layout (Digital): the committed routed GDS of the LibreLane flow (gds workflow run 38074873225 at 6e9a315: TinyTapeout/tt-gds-action@ihp-cmos5l, LibreLane 3.1.0.dev3, IHP-Open-PDK 2bbec755), placed and routed from the LibreLane gate-level netlist reference-asrouted.v by the committed flow (.github/workflows/gds.yaml, src/config.json, src/pdn_cfg.tcl, info.yaml).
